items.title: Ruth Brisbane interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 2, 2013
items.q: His favorite era is he loves Duke Ellington, Monk, Coltrane... I say, 'Oh, that’s ‘Bitches Brew’ and I love it.'

ctx.x: His favorite era is he loves Duke Ellington, Monk, Coltrane, some of them — when we first got married he first bought an album, “Bitches Brew.” I said, “You’ve got on ‘Britches Brew’ again.” He would turn me into a — but you know now I like, when I heard it played on the radio. I say, “Oh, that’s ‘Bitches Brew’ and I love it.”
